chapter: Brass band and the Lyric Theater
title: John Robichaux band personnel
summary: Names the musicians in Robichaux's band, including Harrison Barnes, Willie Pajeaud, Charlie McCurdy and Sam Dutrey Sr.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, Harrison Bones told us about that. Remember? He said he'd go over there.
Yeah, Harrison Bones played with us.
At that same time you were there, huh?
But he was playing the theater when I was there. No, he played with the orchestra. Before? Yeah.
Yeah. Who was in the band when you were there?

Well, with John Robichaud's band they had Willie Paggio. He was playing trumpet. Harrison Bones was playing trombone. Moistad Garner was playing piano. Moistad Garner was playing piano. Old Man Kimball, Kimball's daddy, was playing bass. Willie San Diego was playing banjo. Professor Robichaud was playing violin. And I was playing drums. Clarinet? Did you name him a clarinet? I'm trying to remember. Clarinet? Well, we had old man Charlie McCurdy. He was playing clarinet and sax. What's sax?

Then sometimes we'd have old man Sam Dutre playing with us. Sam Dutre's daddy, the one that played tenor. Did he play tenor or clarinet any time too? No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
